Appearance:
 Shri Surendra Kumar Rajak -Advocate for the applicant
 Shri Satya Pal Chadar- G.A. for the State.
 Shri Sandeep Kumar Sen, learned counsel for the objec
 Order

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 06.09.2024 in connection with Crime No.16/2024 registered at P.S.- STF, Bhopal unit, District Jabalpur, (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 255, 260,
419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that the allegation against the present applicant is that she impersonated as Ritu Pathak and executed sale-deed of land owned and possessed by Ritu Pathak.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in jail since 06.09.2024.
Applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60902 2 MCRC-45792-2024 is an illiterate lady.
She has also lodged a report before the SP that fraud has been committed with her.
It it is also urged that applicant is doing business of flowers.
Son of applicant was suffering from ulcer, therefore, applicant was in need of money.
One Akhilesh Shrivastava was having beetle shop.
Aklhilesh Shrivastava asked for Aadhar Card and other documents from present applicant on the pretext that he will provide her the required money.

sentences.text: Thereafter, Akhilesh Shrivastava took her to bank for loan.
Applicant never executed any sale-deed impersonating herself as Ritu Pathak.
She was not aware about the documents, over which, her thumb impression was taken.
No amount has been credited into the account of present applicant.
Applicant has been made accused on the basis of memorandum of Akhilesh and there are no criminal antecedents of the present applicant.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

6. After examining the role of the present applicant in the alleged offence and nature of evidence available on record pertaining to her involvement in the offence so also the fact that applicant is a lady but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Surekha Samundre be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60902 3 MCRC-45792-2024 the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
